note: Optional-subject topper answer copies. The upstream upsckata.com database is GS + Essay only, so every entry here is community-submitted and maintainer-verified. Add via the Submit form; a maintainer appends accepted entries below.

schema.subject: one of the optional subjects (required)
schema.url: direct link to the copy, hosted elsewhere (required)
schema.verified: true once a maintainer checks it
schema.questions: optional array of { page, question, marks, words } — same shape as GS copies. Produced by the Submit-form analyser or `node extract.js <url> --paper 'Optional — Sociology' --json`. When present, the card shows each question with an Open-PDF-at-page link.
